newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal makes gold swaps but not sales.
newsitem.headline: Portugal makes gold swaps but not sales.

text.p: Portugal's central bank carried out a number of gold swaps towards the end of last year but has not been making any sales from reserves, a spokesman said.

He said this was the explanation for the fact that the country's gold reserves appeared to have fallen by over one million ounces between January 1996 and April 1997, according to figures contained in an International Monetary Fund report.
"There have been no sales," he said.

Once the swaps had expired, then the reserves would return to their previous level. "It is just a temporary reduction," he said, adding that the swaps followed a decision by the bank to adopt a more active management policy towards its reserves.
According to the IMF, Portugal's reserves fell 1.06 million ounces to 14.4 million.
